questions: Did the s-bend off-track count stay at 1 of 20 or fewer with kd 0.8 at wheel_track 0.16?
Did s-bend steering_oscillation stay below about 0.4, and did kd 0.8 reduce it or raise it?
Did the score rise above 661.5 at kd 0.8, or did it fall?
Did slalom line_loss_events or off-track count change from about 1.2 and 20 of 20 with kd 0.8?
Did the oval finish stay at 20 of 20 with kd 0.8?

intent: Revert wheel_track from 0.17 to the best measured value, 0.16, and hold every other geometry field at the iteration 8 values (sensors at y 0.08, 16 mm footprints, x ±0.024 at 12 mm pitch, 0.03 m wheels, 0.12 m body, 0.8 kg). Ask the Integrator to test kd 0.8 on this geometry with kp 4.0 and ki unchanged, so that the race isolates the controller damping. Expected: score near 661.5 on the s-bend and oval, with slalom line_loss and off-track count reported so I can judge whether damping affects the slalom.
learning: Track width at y 0.08 with kp 4.0 rose monotonically from 0.10 to 0.16 (496.4, 561.6, 628.6, 661.5), then fell at 0.17 (651.1) as s-bend exits rose from 1 to 2. The optimum is 0.16, and the wider track is not worth pursuing. Slalom is still 0 of 20 across all geometries tested, so the next test is the controller's damping at the best track width, not further geometry. The earlier wheel_track 0.14 and 0.10 claims were checked against the race data and resolved by the measured trend.
rationale: Iteration 9 tested wheel_track 0.17 and scored 651.1, below the 661.5 of iteration 8 at 0.16. The track-width gain has peaked. The gate in my own intent was an s-bend off-track count above 1 of 20, and the result was 2 of 20 (finished 18), so the gate fires and I revert to 0.16. max_error stayed low at 0.028 and control_effort fell to 8.1, so the wider track was not sluggish. It was over-yawing at the edge of the bends: exits rose even though the average error improved. Oval stayed 20/20 and oscillation stayed well under 0.4. Track width is therefore settled at 0.16, the best measured point. Slalom remains 0/20 at every geometry tested (line_loss 1.0 to 1.35, max_error about 0.063, progress about 0.31), and it is not addressed by track width. Span, footprint and lookahead have already been tested without fixing it. The remaining untested lever that does not disturb the bend result is the controller's damping. I therefore propose returning to the 0.16 geometry unchanged, which gives a deterministic baseline near 661.5, and asking the Integrator to test kd 0.8 on it, as the R1 plan set out. The expected result is a small gain or no change on the s-bend, and a readable slalom line_loss and off-track count from that race.
